items.plain: A person who cannot control themselves is as defenceless as a city whose walls have been torn down.
items.core_idea: Without self-control, a person is defenceless

items.plain: A fire dies when it runs out of wood, and a quarrel dies down when no one keeps gossiping.
items.core_idea: Gossip feeds quarrels; without it they end

items.plain: Don't brag about what you'll do tomorrow, because you have no idea what the day will bring.
items.core_idea: Tomorrow is unknown, so don't boast about it

items.plain: Honest correction said openly is better than love kept hidden. A friend's wounding words can be trusted, while an enemy's many kisses cannot.
items.core_idea: A friend's honest rebuke beats an enemy's flattery

items.plain: A man who strays from his home is like a bird that has wandered away from its nest.
items.core_idea: Leaving home leaves a person unsettled and exposed

items.plain: Don't abandon your friends or your family's old friends. When disaster hits, a neighbour close by is more help than a brother far away.
items.core_idea: A near neighbour helps more than distant kin

items.plain: Just as one piece of iron sharpens another, people sharpen and improve each other.
items.core_idea: Friends sharpen each other

items.plain: As water shows you your face, your heart shows who you really are. Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are human eyes.
items.core_idea: The heart reveals the person; desire never ends

items.plain: Wrongdoers run away even when no one is chasing them, but people who do right are as bold as a lion.
items.core_idea: A clear conscience makes a person bold

items.plain: If you hide your wrongdoing you won't do well, but if you admit it and turn away from it, you will find mercy.
items.core_idea: Confessing wrongs brings mercy; hiding them doesn't

items.plain: A fool lets all their anger out, but a wise person keeps themselves under control.
items.core_idea: The wise restrain their anger

items.plain: Being afraid of what people think traps you, but whoever trusts in God is kept safe.
items.core_idea: Fear of people traps; trust in God protects

items.plain: The speaker asks God for two things before dying: keep lies far away, and give neither poverty nor wealth, just enough, so that riches don't lead to forgetting God or need to stealing.
items.core_idea: Ask for enough, neither poverty nor riches

items.plain: Some things are too wonderful to understand: how an eagle flies, how a snake moves on rock, how a ship crosses the sea, and how a man and a young woman come together.
items.core_idea: Some ways of the world are beyond understanding

items.plain: Four small creatures are very wise: ants store food in summer, rock badgers make homes in cliffs, locusts march in order with no king, and a lizard you can catch lives in palaces.
items.core_idea: Small and weak things can be very wise

items.plain: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves and for everyone left with nothing. Speak up, judge fairly, and see that the poor and needy get justice.
items.core_idea: Speak up for the voiceless and the poor

items.plain: Charm can deceive and beauty doesn't last, but a woman who reveres God deserves praise.
items.core_idea: Reverence for God outlasts charm and beauty

items.plain: Happy is the person who doesn't follow the wicked or mock, but loves God's law and thinks on it day and night. They are like a well-watered tree that bears fruit and doesn't wither.
items.core_idea: Delight in God's law makes a life flourish

items.plain: I lay down and slept, and I woke up again, because God keeps me going. I won't be afraid even of the thousands who surround me as enemies.
items.core_idea: God sustains me, so I need not fear

items.plain: Stand in awe and don't do wrong. Lying in bed, look honestly into your own heart, and be still.
items.core_idea: Search your heart in stillness

items.plain: Many people ask who will ever show them anything good. The psalmist asks God to shine on them, saying God has given more joy than a rich harvest brings.
items.core_idea: God's favour gives more joy than plenty

items.plain: I can lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, God, keep me safe.
items.core_idea: Peaceful sleep comes from trusting God

items.plain: I am worn out from groaning. Every night I soak my bed with tears, and grief and my enemies have made my eyes weak and old.
items.core_idea: Grief can exhaust and overwhelm a person

items.plain: Looking at the sky God made, the moon and the stars, the psalmist wonders why God would think of or care for human beings at all.
items.core_idea: Why would God care for small humans?

items.plain: God will be a strong refuge for the oppressed and for anyone in trouble. Those who know God trust God, because God has never abandoned those who seek him.
items.core_idea: God is a refuge who never abandons seekers

items.plain: How long, God? Will you forget me forever and hide from me? How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and carry sorrow every day while my enemy wins?
items.core_idea: Crying out to God in long sorrow

items.plain: Who may live close to God? The one who lives with integrity, tells the truth, doesn't slander or harm others, keeps promises even when it hurts, and takes no bribes. Such a person will never be shaken.
items.core_idea: An honest, faithful life stands unshaken

items.plain: God has given me my share in life and made it secure, and it is a good one. I keep God always before me, so I will not be shaken.
items.core_idea: Keeping God near, I stay steady and content

items.plain: Death and evil wrapped around me and terrified me. In my distress I called out to God, and God heard my cry.
items.core_idea: In deep distress, God heard my cry

items.plain: God lights my lamp and brightens my darkness. With God's help I can charge through an army and leap over a wall.
items.core_idea: God lights my darkness and gives strength

items.plain: The sky proclaims God's glory and shows what God has made. Every day and night it speaks without words, and its message reaches everywhere.
items.core_idea: The heavens speak wordlessly of God

items.plain: No one can see all their own faults, so the psalmist asks God to forgive hidden ones, guard against deliberate wrongs, and accept his words and thoughts.
items.core_idea: Asking God to forgive faults we cannot see

items.plain: Some people trust in chariots and horses, but we trust in God. They have fallen down, while we get up and stand firm.
items.core_idea: Trust God rather than military strength

items.plain: My God, why have you abandoned me? Why are you so far from helping me? I cry out day and night, and you don't answer.
items.core_idea: Feeling abandoned by God and unanswered

items.plain: I feel poured out and broken: my bones out of joint, my heart melted, my strength dried up, my mouth parched. You have brought me near death.
items.core_idea: Utter physical and emotional exhaustion

items.plain: God is my shepherd, so I have all I need. God gives me rest, restores me and guides me rightly. Even in the darkest valley I won't fear, because you are with me and comfort me.
items.core_idea: With God as shepherd, I fear nothing

items.plain: Show me your ways, God, and teach me. Lead me in your truth, because you are the God who saves me, and I wait for you all day.
items.core_idea: Asking God for guidance and waiting on him

items.plain: Don't hold the wrongs of my youth against me, God. Remember me through your loving kindness and goodness instead.
items.core_idea: Asking God to remember love, not past sins

items.plain: Turn to me and be merciful, God, because I am lonely and suffering. My troubles keep growing. Rescue me, see my pain, and forgive all my wrongs.
items.core_idea: A lonely plea to God for mercy

items.plain: God is my light, my rescue and my strength, so whom should I fear?
items.core_idea: With God as my light, I fear no one

items.plain: Even if my father and mother abandon me, God will take me in.
items.core_idea: God takes in those whom family abandons

items.plain: I am still sure I will see God's goodness while I am alive. Wait for God; be strong and take courage; keep waiting for God.
items.core_idea: Wait for God with courage and hope

items.plain: God's anger lasts only a moment, but his favour lasts a lifetime. Crying may last through the night, but joy comes in the morning.
items.core_idea: Night of weeping, morning of joy

items.plain: When things were going well, I thought nothing could ever shake me. God's favour made me strong, but when God seemed to turn away, I was shaken.
items.core_idea: Security in good times rests on God

items.plain: You turned my grieving into dancing and replaced my mourning clothes with joy, so that I would sing to you and not stay silent. God, I will thank you forever.
items.core_idea: God turns mourning into joy

items.plain: Be merciful, God, because I am in distress. Grief and sorrow are wearing me down, my strength is failing, and even friends and neighbours avoid me and forget me like the dead.
items.core_idea: Grief, weakness, and being shunned by others

items.plain: In a panic I said God had cut me off and no longer saw me. But you heard me when I cried out to you.
items.core_idea: God heard me when I felt cut off

items.plain: While I kept my wrongdoing to myself, I wasted away groaning and felt God's heavy hand on me. When I admitted my sin to God and hid nothing, God forgave me.
items.core_idea: Hiding sin wears you down; confessing brings forgiveness

items.plain: God promises to teach and guide you on the way you should go, watching over you. Don't be like a horse or mule that has no sense and must be controlled with a bit.
items.core_idea: God guides those willing to be taught

items.plain: No king is saved by a big army, and no strong man by his strength. A war horse is a false hope for safety; its power rescues no one.
items.core_idea: Strength and armies cannot truly save

items.plain: I looked for God, and God answered me and freed me from all my fears.
items.core_idea: Seeking God freed me from fear

items.plain: If you want a long and good life, don't speak evil or tell lies. Turn away from wrong and do good. Look for peace and go after it.
items.core_idea: Speak truly, do good, and pursue peace

fix.display_text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies. Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
fix.reason: Missing capital letter after full stop

items.plain: God is close to people whose hearts are broken and rescues those whose spirits are crushed.
items.core_idea: God is near the brokenhearted

items.plain: I treated them with kindness, fasting and mourning when they were sick as if for family, but they repay me with evil and celebrate my troubles, attacking me without stopping.
items.core_idea: Repaid with cruelty for kindness shown

items.plain: God, your loving kindness is precious. People shelter under your care and are richly satisfied. You are the source of life, and in your light we see light.
items.core_idea: God's love is the source of life and light

items.plain: Trust God and do good. Take delight in God, and he will give you what your heart desires. Hand your path over to God, and he will make your goodness shine like daylight.
items.core_idea: Trust God, do good, and delight in him

items.plain: Rest in God and wait patiently. Don't fret when schemers seem to succeed. Let go of anger and rage; fretting only leads you to do wrong.
items.core_idea: Wait on God; don't fret over the wicked

items.plain: A little that belongs to a good person is better than the great wealth of many wicked people.
items.core_idea: Little with goodness beats wealth with wickedness

items.plain: God makes a person's steps firm and delights in their way. Even if they stumble, they won't fall, because God holds them up by the hand.
items.core_idea: Though we stumble, God keeps us from falling

items.plain: I have seen a wicked man in great power, spreading like a lush tree, but then he was gone and couldn't be found. Look at the honest and upright: the peaceful person has a future.
items.core_idea: The wicked fade; the peaceful have a future

items.plain: I am weak and bruised, groaning with anguish. God, you see all I long for and hear my groaning. My strength and sight fail, and my friends and family keep their distance.
items.core_idea: Suffering alone while God sees all

items.plain: God, show me how short my life is and how frail I am. You have made my days only a few hand-widths long; before you my whole life is nothing, every person just a breath.
items.core_idea: Life is brief, like a breath

items.plain: Hear my prayer, God, and don't be silent at my tears. I am only a passing guest with you, like my ancestors. Spare me so I can recover before I am gone.
items.core_idea: A brief guest on earth asking God to listen

items.plain: I waited patiently for God, and he heard me. He lifted me out of a muddy pit, set my feet on solid rock, and gave me a new song of praise that will lead others to trust him.
items.core_idea: Patient waiting; God lifts me from the pit

items.plain: Don't hold back your mercy from me, God; let your love and truth always protect me. Countless troubles surround me, and my wrongs have caught up with me until I can't look up and my heart fails.
items.core_idea: Overwhelmed, asking God's mercy to hold on

items.plain: Even my close friend, someone I trusted and shared meals with, has turned against me.
items.core_idea: Betrayed by a trusted friend

items.plain: As a deer longs for streams of water, my soul longs for you, God. I thirst for the living God. I have cried day and night while people keep asking me where my God is.
items.core_idea: The soul thirsts for God like a deer

items.plain: My soul, why are you so low and troubled inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise him for the help his presence brings.
items.core_idea: Speaking to a despairing soul: hope in God

items.plain: God is our safe place and our strength, always ready to help in trouble. So we will not be afraid, even if the earth gives way and the mountains fall into the raging sea.
items.core_idea: With God as refuge, we need not fear

items.plain: God says: be still and know that I am God, and I will be honoured among the nations and over all the earth.
items.core_idea: Be still and know God

items.plain: Don't be troubled when someone grows rich and their household grows grand, because when they die they take nothing with them, and their glory doesn't follow them.
items.core_idea: The rich take nothing with them at death

items.plain: God, have mercy on me because of your loving kindness. In your great compassion, wipe away my wrongs and wash me clean, because I know what I have done; my sin is always on my mind.
items.core_idea: Asking God to wash away known sin

items.plain: God, make my heart clean and give me a new, steady spirit. Don't send me away from you or take your Spirit from me. Give me back the joy of being saved and a willing spirit.
items.core_idea: A prayer for a clean heart and renewed spirit

items.plain: What God wants as an offering is a broken spirit. God, you will not reject a heart that is broken and sorry.
items.core_idea: God welcomes a broken, repentant heart

items.plain: My heart is in anguish; fear of death, trembling and horror have overwhelmed me. I wish I had wings like a dove so I could fly far away into the wilderness and be at rest.
items.core_idea: Longing to fly away from overwhelming fear

items.plain: If an enemy had insulted me, I could bear it or hide. But it was you, someone like me, my close friend, with whom I shared good times and worshipped God.
items.core_idea: Betrayal by a close friend hurts most

items.plain: Hand your burden over to God, and he will hold you up. He will never let the righteous be shaken.
items.core_idea: Give your burden to God

items.plain: When I am afraid, I will trust you, God. Trusting God and his word, I won't be afraid. What can mere humans do to me?
items.core_idea: In fear, I choose to trust God

items.plain: You keep track of all my wandering, God, and you collect my tears in your bottle. Aren't they all written in your book?
items.core_idea: God counts every tear

items.plain: Be merciful to me, God, because I take refuge in you. I will shelter under your wings until the disaster has passed.
items.core_idea: Sheltering in God until trouble passes

items.plain: Hear me, God, and listen to my prayer. From the far ends of the earth I call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to a rock higher than I am.
items.core_idea: When overwhelmed, asking God for higher ground

items.plain: My soul, wait quietly for God alone; my hope comes from him. He is my rock, rescue and fortress, so I won't be shaken. Trust him always, everyone, and pour out your heart to him.
items.core_idea: Wait quietly on God; pour out your heart

items.plain: Don't rely on oppressing others or take pride in stealing. And if you become richer, don't set your heart on your wealth.
items.core_idea: Don't set your heart on riches

items.plain: God, you are my God, and I will seek you with all I have. My whole being thirsts and longs for you, like someone in a dry, tired land with no water.
items.core_idea: Longing for God like thirst in a desert

items.plain: God, you have tested and refined us like silver. You let us be imprisoned, burdened and trampled; we went through fire and water, but you brought us out to a place of plenty.
items.core_idea: Through trials, God refines and brings us through

items.plain: From his holy home, God is a father to the fatherless and a protector of widows. He gives lonely people a family and leads prisoners out singing, but the rebellious live in a scorched land.
items.core_idea: God cares for the fatherless, widowed and lonely

items.plain: Praise the Lord, who carries our burdens every day, the God who saves us.
items.core_idea: God carries our burdens daily

items.plain: Save me, God, because the water is up to my neck. I'm sinking in deep mud with nothing to stand on. I'm worn out from crying, my throat is dry, and my eyes ache from looking for you.
items.core_idea: Sinking and exhausted, crying out to God

items.plain: Insults have broken my heart, and I feel heavy with sorrow. I looked for anyone to show pity or comfort me, but I found no one.
items.core_idea: Heartbroken and finding no comfort

items.plain: Don't push me away when I am old, God. Don't abandon me when my strength gives out.
items.core_idea: A plea not to be abandoned in old age

items.plain: You have let us see many bitter troubles, God, but you will keep me alive and lift us up again from the depths. Restore my honour and comfort me once more.
items.core_idea: After bitter troubles, God will restore us

items.plain: I almost lost my footing and fell, because I envied proud people when I saw wicked people doing so well.
items.core_idea: Envying the prosperous wicked nearly made me fall

items.plain: I was bitter and grieving, as foolish as an animal before you, yet I am always with you; you hold my hand and guide me. My body and heart may fail, but God is my strength forever.
items.core_idea: Even when bitter, God holds and strengthens me

items.plain: I cry out to God to listen. In my trouble I reached out to the Lord all night, and my soul would not be comforted. Remembering God, I groan; you keep me awake, too troubled to speak.
items.core_idea: Sleepless distress that refuses comfort

items.plain: Has the Lord rejected us for good? Will he never be kind again? Has his love disappeared, his promise failed? Has God forgotten mercy, or held back compassion in anger?
items.core_idea: Asking whether God's love has run out

items.plain: Happy are those who find their strength in God and set their hearts on the journey to him. Passing through the valley of weeping, they turn it into springs, and they grow stronger and stronger.
items.core_idea: Strength in God turns weeping into springs

items.plain: Mercy and truth come together; justice and peace kiss each other. Truth grows up from the earth, and justice looks down from heaven.
items.core_idea: Mercy, truth, justice and peace united

items.plain: Teach me your way, God, and I will live by your truth. Give me an undivided heart that reveres you.
items.core_idea: Asking God for an undivided heart

items.plain: You have taken my friends away and made them turn from me. I'm shut in with no escape, and my eyes are dim with grief. Every day I call to you, God, reaching out my hands.
items.core_idea: Isolated and grieving, still calling on God

items.plain: Remember how short my life is. How fleeting you have made all people! Who can live and never die, or escape the grave?
items.core_idea: Life is short and no one escapes death

items.plain: Lord, you have been our home through every generation. Before the mountains or the world existed, from forever to forever, you are God.
items.core_idea: God is our eternal home

items.plain: We live seventy years, maybe eighty if we are strong, but even the best of them are toil and sorrow, and they pass quickly and we are gone.
items.core_idea: Life is short and quickly over

items.plain: Fill us each morning with your loving kindness, God, so we can be glad all our lives. Give us as many glad days as the days of trouble we have seen.
items.core_idea: Asking for joy to match past sorrow

items.plain: May the Lord our God show us favour and make the work of our hands last; yes, make our work last.
items.core_idea: Asking God to bless and establish our work

items.plain: Whoever lives close to the Most High rests in God's shadow. God is my refuge and fortress, whom I trust. He will rescue you, shelter you under his wings, and you need not fear dangers by night or day.
items.core_idea: Sheltered by God, you need not fear

items.plain: Good people will flourish like palm trees and grow tall like cedars. Planted in God's house, they will thrive and still bear fruit when they are old.
items.core_idea: The righteous flourish even into old age

items.plain: If God hadn't helped me, I would soon have been silenced in death. When I said my foot was slipping, your love held me up, God. When my thoughts crowd in, your comfort cheers my soul.
items.core_idea: God's love holds me up when slipping

items.plain: My heart is withered like grass; I even forget to eat. My groaning has left me skin and bones. I am like a lonely bird in the wilderness, a sparrow alone on a rooftop.
items.core_idea: Withered and alone in deep distress

items.plain: My God, don't take me in the middle of my life. You laid the foundations of the earth and made the heavens; they will wear out like clothes, but you stay the same and your years never end.
items.core_idea: All things wear out, but God endures
items.extended_text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations. Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed. But you are the same. Your years will have no end. The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

items.plain: Praise God with everything in you, my soul, and don't forget all he does: he forgives your sins, heals your diseases, saves your life, surrounds you with love and fills you with good things, renewing your youth.
items.core_idea: Remember and praise all God's goodness

items.plain: God is merciful, kind, slow to anger and full of love. He doesn't punish us as our wrongs deserve, but removes them as far as east from west, caring for us like a father, knowing we are only dust.
items.core_idea: God is compassionate and removes our wrongs

items.plain: A human life is like grass or a wildflower: it blooms, then the wind passes over it and it is gone, and even its place forgets it.
items.core_idea: Human life is brief like grass

items.plain: They wandered in the desert, homeless, hungry and thirsty, and their strength failed. Then they cried to God in their trouble, and he rescued them and led them straight to a city to live in.
items.core_idea: Lost and failing, they cried and God led them home

items.plain: Sailors on the great sea see God's wonders. A storm lifts them high and drops them low until they lose their nerve. They cry to God, and he calms the storm and brings them to the harbour they wanted.
items.core_idea: God calms the storm for those who cry out

items.plain: They answer my love by opposing me, but I keep praying. They have paid me back evil for good and hatred for love.
items.core_idea: Answering hatred for love with prayer

items.plain: My heart is wounded inside me. I am fading like an evening shadow and being shaken off like a locust.
items.core_idea: Wounded and fading away

items.plain: For those who are honest, kind, merciful and just, light breaks through even in the darkness.
items.core_idea: Light dawns in darkness for the good

items.plain: Death had hold of me and I was full of sorrow. I called on God, and he saved me. Rest again, my soul: God has been good to you, rescuing you from death, tears and falling.
items.core_idea: God rescued me; my soul can rest again

items.plain: In my distress I called to God, and God answered by setting me free. God is on my side, so I won't be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
items.core_idea: God is on my side; I won't fear

items.plain: The stone the builders threw away has become the most important stone of all. God has done this, and it is wonderful to see. This is the day God has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
items.core_idea: The rejected becomes the cornerstone; rejoice today

items.plain: I am only a visitor on this earth. Don't hide your commands from me, God.
items.core_idea: A stranger on earth needs God's guidance

items.plain: My soul is worn out with sorrow. Give me strength, God, as your word promises.
items.core_idea: Asking God for strength in weary sorrow

items.plain: It was good for me to suffer, because it taught me your laws, God.
items.core_idea: Suffering taught me God's ways

items.plain: I have seen that every perfect thing has its limit, but your commands, God, have no limit at all.
items.core_idea: All perfection has limits except God's commands

items.plain: Your word, God, is like a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
items.core_idea: God's word lights the way

items.plain: I get up before dawn and cry out for help, putting my hope in your words. I stay awake through the night to think about what you have said.
items.core_idea: Hoping in God's word through sleepless nights

items.plain: I have wandered off like a lost sheep. Come looking for me, God, because I have not forgotten your commands.
items.core_idea: A lost sheep asking God to seek it

items.plain: I have lived too long among people who hate peace. I want peace, but whenever I speak, they want war.
items.core_idea: Wanting peace among those who want conflict

items.plain: I look up to the hills and ask where my help comes from. It comes from God, who made heaven and earth. He won't let you stumble, and the one who watches over you never sleeps.
items.core_idea: Help comes from God, who never sleeps

items.plain: Have mercy on us, God, because we have put up with so much contempt. We are sick of the mockery of comfortable, proud people.
items.core_idea: Weary of contempt, asking God for mercy

items.plain: We have escaped like a bird from a hunter's trap. The trap is broken, and we are free.
items.core_idea: Escaped like a bird from a trap

items.plain: Those who plant with tears will harvest with joy. Whoever goes out crying, carrying seed, will surely come back joyful, carrying the harvest.
items.core_idea: Sowing in tears leads to reaping in joy

items.plain: Unless God builds the house, the builders work for nothing; unless God guards the city, the guards watch for nothing. It's pointless to work early and late, because God gives sleep to those he loves.
items.core_idea: Without God, anxious toil is in vain

items.plain: If you kept a record of every wrong, Lord, no one could stand; but you forgive. I wait for God and hope in his word, longing for him more than night watchmen long for morning.
items.core_idea: God forgives, so I wait and hope

items.plain: God, I am not proud, and I don't busy myself with matters too great for me. I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child resting with its mother.
items.core_idea: A quiet soul, like a child at rest

items.plain: How good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
items.core_idea: Living in unity is good and pleasant

items.plain: Exiled in Babylon, we sat by the rivers and wept, remembering home, and hung up our harps. Our captors demanded happy songs of Zion. How can we sing God's song in a foreign land?
items.core_idea: How can we sing in exile?

items.plain: Even when I am surrounded by trouble, you will give me new life, God. You will reach out against my angry enemies and save me with your hand.
items.core_idea: In the middle of trouble, God revives me

items.plain: God, you have examined me and you know me. You know when I sit and when I get up, you understand my thoughts from far away, and you know every word before I say it.
items.core_idea: God knows me completely

items.plain: Where could I go to get away from you, God? Heaven, the grave, the far side of the sea: you are there, guiding and holding me. Even darkness is not dark to you; night shines like day.
items.core_idea: There is nowhere God is not present

items.plain: You shaped my inner being and knit me together in my mother's womb. I thank you, because I am made in an awesome and wonderful way, and I know your works are wonderful.
items.core_idea: I am fearfully and wonderfully made

items.plain: Examine me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my anxious thoughts. See if there is anything wrong in me, and lead me on the everlasting path.
items.core_idea: Asking God to search my heart

items.plain: I cry out to God for mercy and pour out my troubles. When I was overwhelmed, you knew my way. Traps are set for me; no one cares about me, and there is nowhere to hide.
items.core_idea: Alone and uncared for, crying out to God

items.plain: Answer me quickly, God; my spirit is failing. Don't hide from me. Let me hear of your love in the morning, because I trust you, and show me which way to go.
items.core_idea: Failing spirit asks God for love and direction

items.plain: God, what are human beings that you care about them or think of them? A person is like a breath, and their days pass like a shadow.
items.core_idea: Humans are fleeting, yet God cares

items.plain: God holds up everyone who falls and lifts up everyone who is bent low.
items.core_idea: God lifts up those who fall

items.plain: Don't put your trust in rulers; they are only human and cannot save. When their breath leaves, they return to the ground, and on that day their plans come to nothing.
items.core_idea: Don't trust in mortal rulers

items.plain: God heals people whose hearts are broken and bandages their wounds.
items.core_idea: God heals the brokenhearted

items.plain: I was the smallest and youngest of my brothers, a shepherd who made music. The Lord himself heard me, sent his angel, took me from the sheep and anointed me, though my brothers were tall and handsome.
items.core_idea: God chose the small one over the impressive

items.plain: You have kept going and endured for my name without growing tired. But I hold this against you: you have abandoned the love you had at first.
items.core_idea: Endurance without your first love falls short

items.plain: Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will imprison some of you to test you for a time. Stay faithful even to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
items.core_idea: Stay faithful through suffering, even to death

items.plain: You say you are rich and need nothing, but you don't see that you are wretched, poor, blind and naked. Get true riches, clothing and sight from me instead.
items.core_idea: Self-satisfied wealth hides real spiritual poverty

items.plain: Look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and share a meal with them.
items.core_idea: Christ knocks; whoever opens will share his company

items.plain: These are the ones who came through great suffering and were made clean by the Lamb. Now they serve God, sheltered by him; they will never hunger, thirst or burn again, and God will wipe away every tear.
items.core_idea: After great suffering, God wipes away every tear

items.plain: A voice from heaven says that those who die in the Lord from now on are blessed. The Spirit agrees: they will rest from their work, and their deeds go with them.
items.core_idea: Those who die in the Lord rest

items.plain: A voice from heaven announces that God will live among people as their God. He will wipe away every tear; there will be no more death, mourning, crying or pain, because the old order is gone.
items.core_idea: God will end death, mourning and pain

items.plain: You teach others, so why don't you teach yourself? You preach against stealing, but do you steal?
items.core_idea: Practise what you preach

items.plain: We even rejoice in our sufferings, because suffering builds endurance, endurance builds character, and character builds hope. That hope won't let us down, because God has poured his love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.
items.core_idea: Suffering builds endurance, character and hope

items.plain: I don't understand my own actions. I don't do what I want to do; instead I do the very thing I hate.
items.core_idea: Doing what I hate instead of what I want

items.plain: I believe the sufferings we face now are nothing compared with the glory that will be revealed to us.
items.core_idea: Present suffering is small beside coming glory
